{{Top|leg}}
'''Two Flight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], typically consisting of [[Rogue Five/Legends|Rogue Five]] through [[Rogue Eight/Legends|Rogue Eight]].

This flight was typically led by the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]].

A flight group designated One Flight was also used by [[Wraith Squadron]], led by [[Kell Tainer]].
